answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 49539 Country: India Title: Islamic Dress Question: I have a jubbah which is embroidered with golden stitches and it is below ankle level. Can I wear it during salah? Answer ID: 49539 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 23/23/M=03/1435) It is makrooh tahrimi for male to wear jubbah etc below ankles. Hadith warns on wearing lungi or pyjama etc below the ankles. Committing makrooh act during salah is even worse. You may wear it if you cut it short from the end or fold it and stitch. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
